``` {r}
# Input for graph year
selectInput("year", "Year:", choices = c(2026, 2025, 2024, 2023))

plotOutput("plot")

```

``` {r}
#| context: server

library(tidyverse)

output$plot <- renderPlot({

    # Filter data
    filtered_data <- data_unfiltered |>
    group_by(sample_collect_date) |>
    mutate(year = year(sample_collect_date)) |>
    filter(state_territory == 'vt') |>
    filter(year == input$year)

    # Return graph
    ggplot(
    data = filtered_data
    ) +
    geom_line(
        mapping = aes(
        x = sample_collect_date,
        y = pcr_target_avg_conc
        )
    ) + labs(
        title = input$year
    )
})

```

``` {r}

per_site <- data_unfiltered |> 
    
    filter(state_territory == 'vt') |>

    # Group by each site
    group_by(site) |>

    mutate(pcr_target_avg_conc = if_else(
        pcr_target_avg_conc == 0,
        lod_sewage / 2,
        pcr_target_avg_conc
    )) |>

    # Log transform the concentrations
    mutate(pcr_target_avg_conc = log1p(pcr_target_avg_conc)) |>

    # Only grab data from last 2 years
    filter(sample_collect_date > (if_else(
        month(max(sample_collect_date)) < 8,

        # If we are before August of curr year, use last year's August 1st
        make_date(year = year(max(sample_collect_date)) - years(1), month = 8, day = 1),

        # If we are past August 1st of curr year, use this year's August 1st
        make_date(year = year(max(sample_collect_date)), month = 8, day = 1)) - years(2)
        )
    ) |>

    summarise(
        # 10th percentile
        most_recent_collection_date = max(sample_collect_date),
        avg_conc = pcr_target_avg_conc[which.max(sample_collect_date)],
        baseline = quantile(pcr_target_avg_conc, probs = 0.1),
        std_dev = sd(pcr_target_avg_conc)
    ) |>

    mutate(wval = (avg_conc - baseline) / std_dev)

    # TO DO: Make it the average of most recent week

```
